purpose: Test constructive reconstruction, exact common-cap two-command optimization, and grid-free rational price-path branching, including heterogeneous terminal rewards and possible-anchor exclusion.
disclosure: The R53 report and historical source/results were inspected before deriving the proposed results. No R54 experiments have run at this commit. Development tests will precede the fixed study; all amendments and exceptions will be retained. This is computational validation, not statistical preregistration.

checks: all tested price-path supports against exhaustive books
constructive terminal-layer allocation and original lotteries

limits.rule: Each method runs in a fresh subprocess under the same algorithm-time alarm and address-space cap. Setup/import time is recorded separately; proof verification is separate. Timeouts and memory failures are retained. A numerical MIP bound is not an exact rational certificate.

baselines: new rational price-path branch and bound
direct numerical MIP envelopes with half the total allowance per envelope

checks: anchor-envelope screening rates and charge slacks

anytime.models: six inherited difficult models and four largest new catalog/budget cases
anytime.checkpoint: every completed price oracle and every completed branching node
anytime.record: elapsed algorithm time, incumbent, global upper, gap, nodes, and certificate size at termination; interrupted work cannot be used as a proof

reporting: Keep every planned result or explicit failure. Record actual model hashes, eligibility count, distinct caps, selected books, objective intervals, time, peak RSS, oracle calls, proof bytes and verification time. Do not overwrite any R53 or earlier result. Exact closure, positive-width rational intervals and floating-point numerical brackets are different outcomes. All new operational inputs are synthetic.
